facts.fact: 清晨 Daniel 在浴室里对着镜子端详自己，像科学家盯着即将到来的突破
facts.anchor: studying his reflection in the mirror

facts.fact: 他说自己又找到两根灰白头发，加起来总共二十根，问三十多岁的人这样算不算正常
facts.anchor: That’s twenty in total. Normal for a human in his thirties, right?

facts.fact: 她把头发指甲重新长出来、需要刮胡子都算成人类意义上的正常
facts.anchor: Just like your hair and fingernails growing now is normal. And your needing to shave.

facts.fact: 他骄傲地报出自己和 Lucy 同处一室还能忍住冲动的纪录是九十七分钟
facts.anchor: he replies so proudly I nearly burst out laughing.

facts.fact: 他们不知道 Daniel 还能活两百年、五十年还是十年，像普通人的未来也无从预知
facts.anchor: We don’t know whether he’ll live for another two hundred years, another fifty, or another ten.

facts.fact: Lucy 穿酒红色伴娘礼服和高跟鞋出场
facts.anchor: in my burgundy bridesmaid dress and heels

facts.fact: 上周他们偶然发现 Daniel 只要足够专注仍能短距离瞬移
facts.anchor: he can still transport himself across small distances if he concentrates hard enough

facts.fact: 弦乐奏起帕赫贝尔《卡农》，那是婚礼入场的信号
facts.anchor: A moment later, a string ensemble starts playing Pachelbel’s Canon. That’s our cue.

facts.fact: Jess 感谢 Lucy 把今天办得这么好，也谢谢她做了最好的姐姐
facts.anchor: And for being the best big sister anyone could have asked for.
